title: Microsoft Outage updates: Global outage ends after tech giant restores services across all affected systems
summary: After nearly 24 hours of global outage, lasting from November 12 to November 14, Microsoft restores services across all platforms
llm_summary: Microsoft experienced a near‑24‑hour global outage that began on November 12, affecting Azure, Office 365, Teams, Xbox Live and other core services worldwide. The disruption persisted until early on November 14, when the company confirmed that all affected systems had been fully restored and normal operation resumed.
